assumptions: The standard ₹20 DP charge is used as a conservative default; account-specific depository component can be configured.
GST is applied to brokerage, exchange transaction/IPFT, SEBI and DP charges; STT and stamp duty are excluded from GST.
Two basis points per side is a scenario assumption, not an observed execution cost.
Tax and exchange rates must be rechecked against official schedules before live use.
This file models delivery only, not intraday, F&O, MTF, pledge, call-and-trade or penalties.
